title: The Goat in the Boat
lines: Meg had a goat with a black coat.
The goat got in a small red boat.
A crow sat on the back of the boat.
The goat got up to blow at it.
The boat tipped and the goat fell in.
Meg had to throw a rope to it.
The wet goat swam slow and got back up.

questions.listenFor: The goat stood up to blow at the crow.

questions.ask: How did Meg get the goat back?
questions.listenFor: She threw a rope and the goat swam to it.

questions.ask: Will the goat get in the boat again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for the reason.
